hypotheses.hypothesis: SmartStar Technology Ltd UK is connected to SmartStar Technology Limited NZ
hypotheses.contradicting_evidence: Different directors (Rojs Gordons vs Rex Huang), different countries, different industries, no shared infrastructure, no shared identifiers, incorporated 15 years apart
hypotheses.exculpatory: Coincidental name match is the most likely explanation

hypotheses.hypothesis: UK SmartStar was used for fraudulent purposes
hypotheses.supporting_evidence: 6 dissolved UK companies by same director (pattern of non-compliance)
hypotheses.contradicting_evidence: Company had 8 employees and £263K current assets (real operations), no fraud reports found across 10+ databases, no court cases, no regulatory action, no victim complaints
hypotheses.exculpatory: Administrative dissolution (non-filing) is common for small UK companies and does not indicate fraud

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rojs Gordons is a legitimate software developer

hypotheses.contradicting_evidence: 6 dissolved UK companies (pattern of administrative non-compliance)
hypotheses.exculpatory: Serial company formation with dissolution is common among entrepreneurs

hypotheses.contradicting_evidence: 100% unpaid, only £10K called up, common UK formation practice, actual assets only £263K
hypotheses.exculpatory: Nominal capital declarations are standard practice

hypotheses.hypothesis: smartstar.co.uk was registered for UK SmartStar
